picks.line_source: DraftKings line as carried by ESPN scoreboard, Sep 19 2026
picks.case: Colorado State is 2-0, same as BYU, so a 17.5-point number rests on schedule perception rather than a demonstrated gap. BYU's toughest test so far was a 28-17 home win over Arizona, an 11-point margin that doesn't justify nearly three scores on the road against an undefeated team.
picks.race_effect: Both teams enter 2-0 with no AP ranks published; records offer no reason to treat one program as a class above the other.

trap.why: The crowd sees 2-0 SMU catching just 1.5 at 1-1 Louisville and smells the upset, but Louisville is still the betting favorite at home despite the worse record, signaling the market rates the Cardinals' underlying strength higher. With no SP+ or AP data contradicting that pricing, the facts available don't justify fading the favorite.

notes: Only one honest upset case in the eligible pool. Georgia -24.5 at Arkansas has no case: Georgia has outscored opponents 133-23 while Arkansas's only test was a 43-10 loss at Utah. USC -21.5 at Rutgers has no case on available facts either: USC is 3-0 with a 39-0 shutout of Fresno State, Rutgers is 0-2, and no SP+ or AP data exists to argue the dog is undervalued. No SP+ ratings or AP ranks were provided for any game, so all cases rest on records and results only; trap selection is limited by the same data gap.
